# Colour picker (`color-picker`)

Swatches, HSV field, hue and alpha, hex entry, eyedropper.

Group: Pickers. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/pickers';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createColorPicker` (types in `dist/web/pickers/colorPicker.d.ts`): `.mh-color-picker`: a saturation and brightness area (`role="slider"`, arrow keys move it, Shift by ten), a hueslider, an optional opacity slider, a preview, hex entry, the platform eyedropper where available and a row ofswatches (`aria-pressed` on the current one). Keeps hue and saturation through greys, so dragging to black andback doesn't lose the colour.

```ts
export function createColorPicker(options: ColorPickerOptions = {}): ColorPickerHandle;

export interface ColorPickerOptions {
  /** `#rrggbb`, or `#rrggbbaa` with `alpha`. Default `#ffffff`. */
  value?: string;
  /** Adds the opacity slider; values carry an alpha byte when not opaque. */
  alpha?: boolean;
  /** Quick picks; `false` hides them. Default: a generated set of twelve hues and three greys. */
  swatches?: readonly (string | ColorSwatch)[] | false;
  /** Shows the hex entry (default true). */
  hexInput?: boolean;
  /** Shows the eyedropper where the platform has one (default true). */
  eyedropper?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the whole picker (default "Colour"). */
  label?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** While dragging or typing. */
  onInput?: (value: string) => void;
  /** When a change is committed (drag released, swatch picked, hex entered). */
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
}

export interface ColorPickerHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getValue(): string;
  /** Sets the colour without calling the callbacks; unparseable text is ignored. */
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createColorPicker } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const sample = document.createElement('div');
sample.style.cssText = 'width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: var(--mh-radius-control)';

const lamp = createColorPicker({
  label: 'Lamp colour',
  value: '#ff9a3c',
  // onInput follows every drag; onChange fires once the user lets go.
  onInput: (color) => (sample.style.background = color),
});
sample.style.background = lamp.getValue();

document.body.append(lamp.el, sample);
```

## React API

`ColorPicker` (types in `dist/react/pickers.d.ts`): `createColorPicker` in a host; `value` and `disabled` follow the props.

```ts
export function ColorPicker({ className, value, onInput, onChange, disabled, swatches, alpha, hexInput, eyedropper, label }: ColorPickerProps);

export interface ColorPickerProps extends Omit<ColorPickerOptions, 'onInput' | 'onChange'> {
  className?: string;
  onInput?: (value: string) => void;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ColorPicker } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ColorPickerExample() {
  const [color, setColor] = useState('#ff9a3c');
  return (
    <>
      {/* onInput follows every drag; onChange fires once the user lets go. */}
      <ColorPicker label="Lamp colour" value={color} onInput={setColor} />
      <div style={{ width: 48, height: 48, borderRadius: 'var(--mh-radius-control)', background: color }} />
    </>
  );
}
```
